items.title: Two More Firms Downgraded DraftKings in One Day. Is the Selloff Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBerenberg cut DraftKings to Hold and Wells Fargo cut it to Equal Weight on Nov. 10, with targets of $20 and $21, after a third-quarter report that slashed the company’s 2026 profit outlook.

items.title: Wells Fargo keeps CoreWeave at Overweight, $115 target after funding update
items.summary: CoreWeave's plan to raise under $5 billion of parent-level capital through 2027 and skip unsecured debt at current yields was the bigger positive than the quarter's beat, Wells Fargo said.

items.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Debuts AI Teammate For Wealth Advisors
items.summary: Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) introduced an AI-powered chat assistant called "AI Teammate" within its wealth and investment management unit. The AI Teammate tool is designed to support financial advisors with client queries, planning tasks, and day to day workflow. Wells Fargo reports that AI Teammate is intended to respond to changing client expectations for more modern, tech driven advisory support. items.title: Wells Fargo Tops NYC Commercial Lenders With $5.6B
items.summary: Wells Fargo beat JPMorgan by nearly $2 billion in NYC commercial mortgages, though Chase wrote far more loans, The Real Deal's rankings show.

items.title: PNC Financial's Arm Broadens Digital Push With Stablecoin Payments
items.summary: PNC expands its COIN partnership with stablecoin payment services for corporate clients, aiming to speed up transactions and boost fee-income opportunities.

items.title: Wells Fargo Names Top Pick in Biotechnology Sector
items.summary: Investing.com -- Wells Fargo has identified Annexon, Inc. as its top pick in the biotechnology sector, maintaining an Overweight rating with a price target of $27.00. The firm highlighted the company's compelling setup heading into a critical fourth-quarter 2026 data readout.

items.title: BAC vs. WFC: Which Banking Giant Offers Better Upside Potential?
items.summary: Bank of America edges out Wells Fargo on earnings growth and valuation, but WFC's stronger stock performance and ROE make the investment choice intriguing.
